title: Reversing the invoice unlocks the field and the next invoice re-captures
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}; it has been invoiced (not paid).
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Reverse the invoice of {Work-order-1}.
  2. Click the Sales Representative field.
  3. Click {Sales-rep-B} in the dropdown.
  4. Invoice {Work-order-1} again.
  5. Open Reports > Sales By Representative.
  6. Set the date range to today.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the invoice is reversed and the Sales Representative field can be changed again.
  • Step 2: the dropdown opens.
  • Step 3: the field reads {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 4: the new invoice is created and the field is plain text again, reading {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 5: the Sales By Representative report opens.
  • Step 6: the new invoice of {Work-order-1} is credited to {Sales-rep-B}, not {Sales-rep-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S2-E4: “Changing a representative after the work order is invoiced or paid is not offered. A change sent by any other route is refused with "The sales representative cannot be changed on an invoiced or paid work order." The invoice keeps the names captured when it was created (Story 5). Reversing the invoice unlocks the field again, and the next invoice captures the names afresh.”
  • S5-R1: “When a work order is invoiced, the parts representative and the labor representative in effect are both captured on the invoice, by name.”
